Windows 10 Pro x64

Full disclosure, I am a student and new to CMAKE as well as working with third party C++ libraries, so I hope I will have provided enough information here. On my first attempt building from source, I initially ran into an error telling me that openssl "is not compatible with my version of Windows", yet when installing and setting to %path% both the 32 bit version, verifying it works with "openssl -v", then repeating the process with the 64 bit version, I was able to get both running just fine outside of working with this repo. I left the 64 bit version installed and tried again by starting over from the beginning, and now I don't even reach that stage. When trying to build again, I receive the following error message. 

```

```
mavsdk.lib(curl_wrapper.obj) : error LNK2019: unresolved external symbol "__declspec(dllimport) public: class std::basic_istream<char,struct std::char_traits<char> >
